The paper studies semiparametric regression, explains that asymptotic linearity can fail when only one nuisance is consistently estimated, and develops additional-nuisance approaches to doubly robust inference.

The paper develops cross-fitting and doubly robust estimators with product-form remainder control for average linear functionals; it is a general methodological comparator rather than a dynamic-panel DATE result.
